approvers: Developer or main contractor, glazing subcontractor
reason: Glazing protection until handover is the glazing subcontractor's job, not mine, and the main contractor decides what protection is specified and who pays. I don't buy this today and I'm not opening a new budget line for it.
objection: At about 19 euro per m2 against film and tape at well under 1 euro per m2 in material, nobody in my chain will pay for it, and it isn't my cost to carry anyway.
instead: Keep using cheap film and tape, or leave it to the glazing subcontractor as the package already says.
would_change_my_mind: The developer or main contractor writing it into the subcontract spec and paying for it separately, so it costs me nothing.
